competitor_reconciliation.true_missing_disposition: every BringFido lead no census node carried was worked through an authorized identity lane: Google Places gap verification (existing free allowance) placed each at its own postal code or refused it; a verified missing hotel became a census identity through the Places lane and its own page decided its policy. A competitor name never admits an identity and its pet claims are never read.

review_leads_audit.rule: a REVIEW lead is one the automatic match could not place. The REVIEW leads carrying a hotel brand word (Comfort Suites Fort Myers East I-75, MainStay Suites Fort Myers East I-75, Quality Inn Fort Myers Cape Coral) match census nodes HELD for a founder ruling -- a dual-brand campus at 9455 Old Luckett Rd and a rebrand at 4760 S Cleveland Ave -- each read first-party on choicehotels.com; '23 Palms at Ivy Inn' names no licensed premises; the rest are private homes, condos, RV spots and unit listings by their own names.
